product.name: Sunofriend
product.independence: Unsigned Media Ltd project; not related to or affiliated with Suno Inc.

passed: uv-managed CPython 3.11 environment and all runtime dependencies installed
doctor --require preview including a FluidSynth render smoke test
source-doctor with local FFmpeg and FFprobe
partially_verified.blocked: Native demo/create imports POSIX-only fcntl through source-lineage locking and stops with No module named 'fcntl'.

platform_testing.support_boundary: macOS remains supported. Native Windows setup and offline diagnostics are partially verified, but the normal demo/create workflow is blocked; Linux and Windows Subsystem for Linux are unverified.
platform_testing.feedback_requested_from: Every Sunofriend user, especially anyone trying another coding agent or repeating the Windows and Linux portability work.

agent_entry.preferred_surface: Any skills-aware coding agent with explicit local workspace and command access
agent_entry.skill_portability: The plain-text skill is designed for capable coding agents including Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity; use the agent's native skill mechanism or provide SKILL.md directly.
agent_entry.standard_chat_boundary: A standard ChatGPT conversation may guide but must not claim local execution.
two_turn_start: Install and read the official skill using the agent's native skill mechanism; in Codex, use $skill-installer. Do not install the app or audio dependencies. Confirm availability, then stop.
Explicitly invoke the installed skill in a new turn; in Codex, use $sunofriend. Inspect first, explain changes, then offer the four newcomer routes.

installation_protocol.stage_1: Run the read-only plan. If source is absent, ask before preparing only the source checkout.
installation_protocol.stage_2: Rerun the plan, show the exact 40-character commit, and ask separately before installing that same reviewed commit.

newcomer_routes.input: one authorised finished song on a supported Apple-silicon Mac
newcomer_routes.action: plan and explicitly install the separate pinned alpha runtime, then use sunofriend-separate for local broad vocals and instrumental estimates; listen before any later MIDI step
prepare supported non-WAV or mixed-format parts with source-import-folder, then use sunofriend create PROJECT --out-dir FRESH; prefer Simple / Make my song when the person operates the TUI

explain DAW export, independent authorised stem services or Sunofriend's experimental local separator; broad two-stem remains default and installed SCNet is an explicit public opt-in core-four preview
create copyright-safe synthetic stems and run the normal automatic MIDI/WAV/ZIP path in a fresh output directory

stem_inputs.stem_definition: a grouped submix such as drums, bass, vocals or keys; not necessarily one isolated instrument
stem_inputs.ai_separated_stem_definition: an estimate of a category from a finished mix, not the lost original studio track
stem_inputs.built_in_full_mix_separation_scope: experimental Apple-silicon local command defaulting to broad vocals and instrumental; installed SCNet provides an explicit public opt-in vocals/drums/bass/grouped-other preview
stem_inputs.multi_format_import_scope: 2–64 already-separated synchronized top-level supported audio parts per source-import-folder execution
stem_inputs.role_map_contract: path to a flat JSON object keyed by exact source filename
stem_inputs.observed_pads_boundary: pads are currently synthesized from keys; map only a genuinely string-like sustained source to strings, otherwise leave it unresolved
stem_inputs.metronome_boundary: timing evidence, not an accepted S1 source-folder role
stem_inputs.composite_drums_boundary: preserved as source evidence pending S2
stem_inputs.origin_compatibility_tolerance: max(0.010 seconds, 2 frames at the lowest source sample rate)
stem_inputs.horizon_warning_tolerance: max(0.050 seconds, 2 frames at the lowest source sample rate)

song_generation.plan_command: sunofriend song-generate REFERENCE --lyrics LYRICS --style DESCRIPTION --reference-strength 0.5 --style-strength 0.5 --out-dir FRESH
song_generation.native_remix_plan_command: sunofriend song-generate REFERENCE --lyrics LYRICS --style DESCRIPTION --reference-strength 0.2 --style-strength 0.8 --generation-mode remix --out-dir FRESH

agent_create.audience: newcomer working through a local agent

studio.candidates: multiple analytical, AI and repair methods remain separate

vocal_comping.working_private_scope: reviewed phrase playback, aligned browser pickup recording, target-relative evidence and explicit human feedback
required_inputs: multiple synchronized vocal-only takes or aligned browser pickups
vocal_comping.human_authority: listen before revealing scores; explicitly choose a phrase base, request another pickup, or retain a clearly labelled AI region
vocal_comping.recommended_whole_song_route: one broad human base performance plus guided phrase pickups, followed by reviewed joins and optional gentle correction
vocal_comping.unit_policy: phrase or line by default; word or syllable substitutions only as reviewed rescue edits
known_evidence_limits: speech transcription is phonetic timing evidence and cannot rewrite canonical lyrics
MIDI is a melodic skeleton and cannot represent diction, breath, tone or expression
consonant and guttural closures may be intentionally unpitched
an automated ranking is not a take selection or musical preference

finished_mix_separation.working_public_scope: one authorised finished mix to broad vocals, broad instrumental and diagnostic reconstruction on Apple-silicon macOS
finished_mix_separation.downstream_proof: stems the musician finds useful can enter the existing automatic MIDI, interpretation WAV and starter ZIP workflow as a later explicit step
finished_mix_separation.evidence_scope: three source-distinct private evidence chains with complete-song and boundary listening, plus a public end-to-end generated-audio smoke test
development_method: seal authorised inputs and run one bounded local experiment
check machine evidence without treating it as musical preference
bind explicit human listening to the exact result
preserve useful, poor and inconclusive evidence

runtime.compatibility_inspection: torch.load(weights_only=True, map_location='cpu'); strict keys, shapes and dtypes; no forward pass or audio read

activation_requires: three repeat resource runs on the approved first verified machine class
one complete catastrophic-output listen per canary

supported_machine.first_verified_class: Apple M3 Max with 36 GB unified memory

known_limitations: The mathematical synthetic vocal estimate was extremely quiet and vocal reference content remained mainly in grouped other.
Exact reconstruction accounting does not prove accurate source assignment.
16 GiB and other Apple-silicon classes are accessible but unverified.

failed_profiles.summary: The pinned runtime retained 39/5 as a string inside HTDemucs valid_length after the one numeric apply-model remediation.
The exact install and doctor passed, but the worker rejected the model's native Fraction(39, 5) segment before inference.

other_refinement.candidate_known_objective_issue: Resolved by the one allowed exact in-memory Fraction(39, 5) normalization; the pinned config remained byte-identical.
